stemMarkdown: 23 workers, each working 7 hours a day, can complete a job in 16 days. How many days will 30 workers, each working 7 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 23 \times 16 \times 7$ worker-hours $= 2576$. With 30 workers at 7 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{2576}{30\times7} = 12.27$.
